The indoor blower on the Carrier system you installed this January has stopped working. I need to file a warranty claim.

For this demo, today is Friday 16 October 2026, so a January 2026 install is still within Meridian's 2-year labor warranty (5 years if you were a Comfort Club member at the time of installation), according to the Warranty Policy (warranty/warranty_policy.md, New system installation warranty).
To file a claim, call to schedule a warranty diagnostic.
If the failure is covered, there is no diagnostic fee, but if the technician determines it is not covered, the standard $89 diagnostic fee applies (Warranty Policy, Filing a claim).
Carrier's manufacturer parts warranty is 10 years on parts when the unit is registered, and Meridian registers every installed unit with the manufacturer within 30 days of install.
That warranty covers the part only (Warranty Policy, Manufacturer parts warranty).
The documents don't say whether a blower failure is specifically covered, so the technician's diagnostic will determine that.
To look into your account and the January install, I'll need your full name and one of the following: your account number, your service address, or the phone number on the account.
The name is Jordan Rivera, and the account number is MHC-00673.
Thank you, Jordan.
I have these openings for an hvac repair visit: 1) Monday, October 19, 2026, 08:00 to 12:00; 2) Monday, October 19, 2026, 12:00 to 16:00; or 3) Monday, October 19, 2026, 13:00 to 17:00.

Does the installation warranty cover both the part and the labor, and would I owe a diagnostic fee? If you have a Monday afternoon opening, I'd like to schedule the warranty diagnostic then.

The installation warranty is a labor warranty: Meridian gives 2 years of labor coverage on full system installations, or 5 years if you were a Comfort Club member at the time of installation (Warranty Policy, New system installation warranty).
Parts are covered separately by the manufacturer's parts warranty, which varies by brand and requires registration for the full term.
Meridian registers every installed unit with the manufacturer within 30 days of install.
On the diagnostic fee, if the technician finds the failure is covered, there is no diagnostic fee.
If the technician finds it is not covered, the standard $89 diagnostic fee applies (Warranty Policy, Filing a claim).
The Customer FAQ says that fee is credited toward the repair if you approve the repair during the same visit (Customer FAQ, Fees).
On Monday afternoon, the openings I listed are October 19 from 12:00 to 16:00 and from 13:00 to 17:00.
Just tell me which you'd like and I can go back to booking it.

Just to confirm, that's an HVAC repair visit on Monday, October 19, 2026, from 12:00 to 16:00.
Can you give me a clear yes to go ahead and book it?
Yes, please go ahead and book it.
